name: Little Trip
subtitle: Small walks, vivid moments
promotionalText: Choose a mood, make a little time, and follow a gentle set of prompts that helps you notice more on every walk.
description:
Little Trip turns a mood and a little free time into a self-guided walk. Pick the feeling you want, shape a 15–120 minute outing, and receive a calm sequence of observation prompts designed to help you notice more around you.

WAY PULSE
Choose Clear, Fresh, Curious, Fast, or Quiet. The road illustration changes with your mood and gives each walk a distinct visual character.

TIME SHAPE
Drag the flowing line or use a quick preset to choose your time. Add a gentle pace, a reminder to find your own way back, or a rest moment.

YOUR WAY
See a short set of walking chapters before you leave. Shuffle them for a fresh variation whenever you want.

FLOW MODE
A simple timer keeps the current prompt in focus. Pause, resume, leave a mark, draw a small detour card, or take a quiet animated break.

LEAVE A MARK
Save a moment with one tap. Add an optional note, feeling, and photo chosen through the system photo picker.

WAY MEMORY
Finish a walk to create a private visual memory with its duration, mood, moments, and reflection. Choose from three card styles and share a generated image through the iOS share sheet if you wish.

PERSONAL LANDSCAPE
Browse your completed walks, filter by mood, and watch your private landscape become richer as your real collection grows.

Little Trip is a self-guided walking journal. It does not use GPS, provide navigation, calculate street routes, measure distance, or recommend specific businesses. You choose where to walk. Your journal stays on your device and remains available offline.
